title: feat(fields): Setup's notification topic and channel fields pick from the served list and still take a typed value
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoC9MDip31tiDLU5QajkcAgR)_

Fixes #31062
Part of #30208

Clause-②: yes (widening) — five new `fields.preferenceOption.*` keys in every published `@object-ui/i18n` pack, and `field:notification-topic` / `field:notification-channel` join `@object-ui/fields`' registered widget keys (`RegisteredFieldWidgetType`); nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 的通知偏好(主题、渠道)和通知模板(主题)不再是纯文本框,改成下拉选择器,列表来自服务端 `preference-options` 接口,`*` 排第一;仍可直接输入列表外的值。
- 为什么改:管理员手敲主题/渠道容易打错(如 `invoices.paid`、`emial`),通知就会静默不发或发错渠道;按裁决 E(#30527)给出可选列表并保留自由输入。
- 风险与回滚:只影响声明了 `notification-topic` / `notification-channel` 的三个字段;接口失败或返回空列表时退回原来的文本框;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx`(填充分支 `PreferenceOptionField`)、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/preferenceOptions.ts`(读取与共享请求)、`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`(注册)。
- 两分钟验证:打开 Setup → Notification Preferences → New,点 Topic,应看到 "All topics (*)" 排第一的列表;在搜索框输入 `invoices.paid` 点 "Use …",字段显示 "invoices.paid (not in the list)";Channel 列表里 push 显示 "(not configured)" 且可选。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `43dd3c69` 的 diff 复核：24 个文件、+776 / −28，无受治理路径。设置里通知偏好与模板的「主题」「渠道」字段改为可填写的下拉：列表来自 `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options`（经宿主已认证的 fetch，整页共用一次请求），`*` 排在最前；手输的值原样保存，不在列表中的值保留并标注；未配置的渠道照列、标注、可选；请求失败或列表为空时回到原来的文本框。新增五条文案进所有语言包。Clause-② 改为 yes (widening)，席位 TIER_DEFAULT 复核 PASS（6700168365）。CI 全绿，同意落地。

## What changes

`sys_notification_preference.topic` / `.channel` and `sys_notification_template.topic` declare `widget: 'notification-topic'` / `'notification-channel'` since #31004; nothing registered them, so they rendered as text boxes. This PR registers both as `field:WIDGET` keys in `@object-ui/fields`, so the record form picks them up with no per-page code.

**Home: option (a), a fillable arm on `RegistryRefField`.** It registers through `fieldWidgetMap`, the field widget registry the record form already consults for `FieldSchema.widget`, beside `position-ref` / `permission-ref`; option (b) would live in `app-shell` beside `FlowReferenceField`, which only the flow inspector reads, and would need its own route into the record form. The arm reuses the registry picker's four-state catalog machinery (IDLE / LOADING / FAILED / LOADED, generalised from `useRegistryCatalog` to `useCatalog(reader, origin, list)` with one module-level reader per arm), and differs from the registry arm only where an open list must:

- **The list** comes from `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options` through the host's authenticated fetch (`SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`, the console's existing `createAuthenticatedFetch` path; no new fetch helper). One request per fetch function for the page, shared by the topic and the channel field; a failed read is not kept. Listed in the server's order, `*` first, shown as "All topics (*)" / "All channels (*)".
- **No list** (no host fetch, a failed or malformed answer, or an empty list): the plain text box, with no notice. The registry arm's failure banner is not shown here.
- **A typed value**: the picker's search box offers a "Use "TEXT"" row that commits the text exactly as typed. A stored value the list lacks stays its own option, marked "TEXT (not in the list)" (`data-not-in-list`), on the edit and the read face. Nothing is refused or rewritten.
- **A channel the server marks not configured** is listed as "push (not configured)" (`data-not-configured`) and is selectable.
- **Strings**: five `fields.preferenceOption.*` keys in every console pack; `zh-Hant` regenerated from `zh-Hans` with `gen:zh-hant`.
- **Registration ripple, the `position-ref` (objectui#7611) ripple**: `FIELD_WIDGET_LABELLING`, the bare-name skip list, `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES` and the two fields widget sweeps; under the seat's claim amendments 6699576193 and 6699989026, two `widgetHintOnly` rows in `app-shell` `paramValueShape.ts`, the two names in `plugin-detail`'s `inlineEditTypeCoverage` excluded bucket, and `ui/packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` regenerated by `node ui/scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` (two lines, no hand edit). The `de` quote census moves 108 → 109 for the new `„{{value}}“ verwenden` row.

Out of scope, unchanged: the template's `channel` (`channel_renders_template`, no widget, still a text box), quiet hours, row 5 of #30208, any server change.

## Tests

`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RegistryRefField.preferenceOptions-31062.test.tsx`, 14 cases:

- the list renders from the route (`*` first, the door's order, one shared read for two fields), and both keys resolve through `field:WIDGET` in the registry;
- the fallback to the text box when the route answers 500, when the fetch rejects, when the list is empty, and when no host fetch exists (nothing read);
- a value outside the list is committed as typed and shown marked, on the edit and the read face;
- a "not configured" channel is shown labelled and is selectable.

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src import, no build in the path): deleting the `'notification-topic'` loader from `fieldWidgetMap` turns "`notification-topic` is registered and lists the door" red (`expected undefined to be defined`, 1 failed / 12 passed); restore verified blob == HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-② is copied from the claim (`no`). The PR adds five keys to every published `@object-ui/i18n` pack and two registered widget keys; some recent i18n-key PRs declared that `yes (widening)` and some `no`, so the seat may want to amend.
- Open PR #31037 also edits all ten hand-written `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs, in a different block; whichever lands second takes a textual merge.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` needs a Console build and is CI's: the arm adds code to `@object-ui/fields`, which rides the eager `ui-components` chunk.

## Verification

Readings name their tree. Gates and type-check at `da4d45a2`; the last commit `1fc7c752` adds only the regenerated `known-schema-types.ts`, and the ui `scripts/` suite was re-run on it. Re-deriving at `1fc7c752` gives the same 38 families.

<details><summary>Live before, on main 23cf11a4 (showcase backend --fresh, Console dev server, admin sign-in)</summary>

- Setup → Notification Preferences → New: Topic and Channel are `INPUT type=text`, prefilled `*`. Notification Templates → New: Topic and Channel are `INPUT type=text`. No request to the options route.
- `GET /api/v1/messaging/preference-options` (signed in): `200`, 28 topics (`*` first, then `approval.*`, `auth.*`, `collab.mention`, the showcase flow topics such as `invoice.signoff`, `project.digest`, `task.assigned`, and `notify`), 5 channels: `*`, `inbox`, `email`, `sms`, and `push` with `configured: false`. Anonymous: `401`.
</details>

<details><summary>Live after, on this branch (same backend)</summary>

- Notification Preferences → New: Topic trigger reads "All topics (*)", its list has 28 options with "All topics (*)" first; Channel lists `All channels (*)`, `inbox`, `email`, `sms`, `push (not configured)`.
- Typed `invoices.paid` in the topic search and picked "Use …": the trigger reads "invoices.paid (not in the list)" with `data-not-in-list=true`. Picked `push (not configured)`. Save, then `GET /api/v1/data/sys_notification_preference` reads back `topic: invoices.paid`, `channel: push`.
- Notification Templates → New: Topic is the picker; Channel stays `INPUT type=text`.
- The options route answered `200` once per page load.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RegistryRefField.preferenceOptions-31062.test.tsx`: 14 passed.
- `packages/fields/` whole, `packages/i18n/`, `packages/components/src/renderers/form/`, the plugin-form `position-ref` form test, the app-shell form-type guards and the cli ratchet: 8 reds before the ripple rows (all named above), then green on the rerun of every red file (361 + 367 + 48 tests).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` after a dts build of their closure: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 38 families; every line exit 0)</summary>

Reconciled with `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Record: `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat-2/r2026-11-06/31062/gates-ran-1fc7c752.list`. Includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (exit 0), `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `pnpm check:type-check-coverage`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, `pnpm check:undeclared-dep-imports`, the changeset gates, and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 passed, 2 skipped).
</details>
